source: select w.name,sum(l.qty_on_hand),sum(l.qty_on_hand*p.unit_cost) from dash_demo.stock_levels l left join dash_demo.warehouses w on l.warehouse_id=w.warehouse_id left join dash_demo.products p on l.product_id=p.product_id group by 1

select p.category,count(*),count(case when l.qty_on_hand<l.reorder_level then 1 end),1.0*count(case when l.qty_on_hand<l.reorder_level then 1 end)/nullif(count(*),0) from dash_demo.stock_levels l left join dash_demo.products p on l.product_id=p.product_id group by 1
